questions.example: Our supplier does not have enough capacity to make 10,000 units this month.
questions.exampleZh: 我們的供應商這個月沒有足夠產能生產一萬個。

questions.example: We shared our three-month forecast with the vendor.
questions.exampleZh: 我們把未來三個月的需求預測分享給廠商。

questions.example: The price validity of this offer is 30 days.
questions.exampleZh: 這份報價的價格有效期是30天。

questions.example: Who will pay the customs duty for this shipment?
questions.exampleZh: 這批貨的關稅由誰支付？

questions.example: The cargo arrived at the port yesterday.
There is still an outstanding balance of USD 2,000 on this invoice.
questions.exampleZh: 這張發票還有2,000美元尚未付清。

questions.example: Please use stronger packaging to avoid damage.
questions.exampleZh: 請使用更堅固的包裝，以免損壞。

questions.prompt: 情境：你想請廠商幫忙確認某品項還有沒有庫存，最自然的說法是？
options: Could you check the stock for this item?
questions.example: Could you check the stock for this item before we place the order?
questions.exampleZh: 在我們下單前，可以請您確認這個品項的庫存嗎？

questions.prompt: 情境：你寫信提醒廠商，你們還在等對方的報價單，最自然的說法是？
options: We are wait for your quotation.
We are still waiting for your quotation.
questions.example: We are still waiting for your quotation. Could you send it by Friday?
questions.exampleZh: 我們還在等您的報價單，可以在週五前寄給我們嗎？

questions.prompt: 情境：你在信件中想請對方看下方的訂單細節，最自然的說法是？
options: Please see below for the order details.
Below you see please the details.
questions.example: Please see below for the order details and delivery address.
questions.exampleZh: 訂單細節與送貨地址請見下方。
